audiomoth._clip_note: Rolling % of samples at/above clip_sample_level (0-1 full scale) that lights the CLIP indicator on the monitor and logs a warning per segment. Advisory only.

microphone._block_size_note: Samples per recorder.record() call. 32768 (~171 ms @ 192 kHz) settled 2026-09-07: the first read over-primes PipeWire's ring buffer by ~block_size^1.36, so a smaller block cuts the fixed A/V-sync latency term (~597 ms at 131072 -> ~90 ms here). 32768 rode a stress-ng-hammered Pi with zero dropped blocks where 8192 got marginal. The residual (buzzer self-test 2026-11-06: ~21 ms, varying ~5 ms sd per recording, not per device) can be subtracted in audio_align.parse_mic_sidecar; a dropped block is lost audio. See plans/audio-video-sync-residual-validation.md.
microphone._latency_probe_note: Log PipeWire's reported stream latency after every block (LAT lines in the _timestamps.txt sidecar) to test a per-recording audio anchor. Diagnostic; costs one audio-server round trip per block. See plans/audio-video-sync-residual-validation.md.

monitoring._palette_note: colour_mode: 'palette' (colormap over the whole spectrogram) or 'bands' (call_bands, grey elsewhere); unset = bands if any are on. colormap: a built-in palette name (src/shared/spectrogram_palettes.json). colormap_stops: [[pos 0-1, '#rrggbb'], ...] for a custom palette, written by the controller; overrides colormap when set. call_bands: [{label, lo_hz, hi_hz, palette, enabled}] -- each band drawn in its own palette, everything outside the bands grey. See plans/spectrogram-palettes-and-call-bands.md.

sync_pulse._note: A/V sync test rig on this Pi's GPIO (BCM numbering): a piezo buzzer and/or an LED fired together by the sync_selftest / sync_pulses commands. drive 'dc' = active buzzer (pin high), 'pwm' = passive piezo driven at tone_hz (hardware-timed when the pin has a pwm-pio overlay channel, which allows ultrasonic tones such as 25000; software PWM otherwise, max 10000). mic_distance_m removes the sound's flight time. Pins null = rig not fitted. See docs/AV_SYNC_TEST.md.

_audiomoth_sync_offsets_ms_note: Per-AudioMoth audio anchor offset, serial -> ms: how far the stream-latency anchor places sample 0 from the truth. Written by sync_selftest (buzzer next to the AudioMoth); the recorder copies it into each sidecar (LATENCY_OFFSET_MS) and audio_align subtracts it. Missing = audio_align's default. See docs/AV_SYNC_TEST.md.
